about_the_game:
Urbanist is a strategy and simulation game about transforming small settlements into thriving cities and vibrant neighborhoods. Build up your island, manage resources and production chains, and earn your reputation as the next great Urbanist.

Thousands of citizens, thousands of stories.

From the morning rush to the late-night glow, your city is alive with thousands of citizens, each following their own routines. They work in industrial and commercial sectors, clock in at factories, deliver goods, and make their way home after dark through the streets you built.

Organic Movement

Citizens move naturally through the world, forming queues at supermarkets, clubs, and public spaces. Every building has a limit, and slow service processing can quickly lead to long waiting times, blocking the streets for others passing by. Improve efficiency, expand capacity, or redesign your districts. Optimize your services - or risk impatient crowds clogging your streets.

Dynamic Lives

After long workdays, citizens decide how to spend their leisure time based on their needs and desires - visiting museums, cinemas, resorts, or spas. Providing opportunities for leisure and wellness prevents burnout and keeps them healthy.

Physical Economy

All resources are made, moved, and used by your citizens. Workers produce items in buildings, bring them to shops and services, and people use them as part of their everyday routines. Strong supply lines keep your city growing.

Global Tourism

Tourists from nearby cities explore your city and leave personal ratings based on their experiences. From monumental sights to specialized tourist services, your city’s reputation depends on meeting their expectations.

Corporate Drama

A boardroom of corporate executives monitors your progress, evaluating your performance as you strive to become the next great Urbanist. Fulfill their requests to keep the board satisfied!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 1.7 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R9 380 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070, Radeon RX 5700 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
